purpose: Replay pin for the PE-01 witness (AGENTS.md §A.42 item 1). The 16 records in this directory are byte-identical to PR #923 at cd4064818fe2cff1ee4b147a9761ed157bcf990c. This file states the previously verified results these records carry, gives instructions for reproducing the checks behind the existence statement at book/ch18-beyond.md:106 (mirrored at book/The-Incompleteness-of-Observation-FULL.md:4919), and names the statements in these records that are provenance only.

owner_decision.author: amaybaum
owner_decision.recorded: 2026-11-04T10:46:49Z (Claude Code session chat, quoted in the comment above)
owner_decision.quote_note: Verbatim from the comment above, with its four paragraphs joined by spaces.
owner_decision.quote: I approve the #923 disposition, with option (a), inclusion of A1–A3, and conditional authorization to close #923 without merging. Use the exact numerical results already independently reviewed, together with the three reproducibility scripts. The recipe must identify the inputs, commands, expected outputs, and provenance sufficiently for another reader to reproduce the checks. No scripts need to run now. Clearly distinguish previously verified results from instructions for future reproduction. Include all three [A1–A3] for completeness and provenance. Label historical decisions and superseded interpretations clearly. These notes must not silently introduce new scientific claims or override accepted conclusions. Authorize preparation and independent review of the separate PR containing the 16 files. Do not merge that PR without my explicit approval of its reviewed head, scope, and CI results. The chapter 18 evidence must remain accurately described as branch-only until it is integrated.

landing_commit: the merge commit of the landing PR. The PR lands by a merge commit, not by squash or rebase. The commit that added this file to main is also given by git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- <this file's path>.

supports.statement: book/ch18-beyond.md:106: an embedded observer whose actions reach the hidden state driving a deterministic source can, for some sources, predict its output better than chance.
needs: a positive prediction advantage against a reference law Q_p = 1/2
an embedded observer: EX1 (bijective maps) and EX8 (observer maps leave the hidden component fixed)
activity: the observer's interventions select the generator's clocking (the mechanism)

demonstrated: prediction is a guess of the visible bit X_K' against the reference law Q_p = 1/2
one fixed finite reversible realization: G_clk(z^5+z^2+1) at n = 5, mu uniform, the T-level condition C1 only, C2-C4 unchecked
one horizon cell: K = 7, window K' = 4..7, advantage 1/8 to 5/32
an active observer whose tables are chosen for this generator (K1); it gives no window on the other five primitive quintics
the advantage uses the generator's visible-to-hidden backaction
admissibility holds in the selected resource model only: theta = n+1 with footprint 6 = theta, and the 31-bit tables held in the dynamics and not charged as state
limits: it refutes the universal form only and says nothing about typical realizations, the actual world or ch18's 10^-32 statement (REVIEW.md:148-149)
G_clk is the plan's deliberately non-autonomous comparator (REVIEW.md:157-158)

it does not show predictability for passive observers, for autonomous-hidden generators, at K0, beyond K = 7, asymptotically in n or at theta = n, nor that G_clk(p_5) satisfies C2-C4 (REVIEW.md:170-179)
witness_scope.run_only: REVIEW.md:250's statement that no passive witness and no autonomous-generator witness exists in any admissible cell rests partly on the run: the general passive m = 3 sweep and the linear-filter m = 4 sweep at n = 8 were not enumerated independently (REVIEW.md:195-196). It is not part of what supports.statement needs.

They are recorded in review/results/REVIEW.md, and the PR #923 coordinator reran every script and found each output matching (PR #923 comment 6409658619). construction: Run from the top level of a clone of amaybaum/incompleteness that contains the landing commit. R is an absolute path to an empty directory.
instructions_for_future_reproduction.construction_note: verification/programmes is export-ignore in .gitattributes, so git archive omits it. The temporary-index construction writes only review/results/ into $R, which also keeps search.py from overwriting the checked-in search_out.json.

environment.broader_scope_commands: python3 with numpy; the numpy version used by the reviewer is not recorded
environment.isolation: python3 -I -B, as review/results/README.md states. Each script that imports a sibling inserts its own directory into sys.path. -I ignores PYTHONPATH and user site-packages, so numpy must be installed in the interpreter's own site-packages or in a virtual environment.

instructions_for_future_reproduction.check_method: The scripts assert nothing and exit 0. The three statement scripts print exact rationals (fractions.Fraction) and booleans; family.py prints unreduced k/128 strings, and search.py and plin.py print integers and dicts. Compare the printed values with previously_verified_results. The one byte-exact expected file is search_out.json.

historical_decision_records.standing: A1, A2 and A3 are historical records of the owner's decisions that governed PE-01 before and after its run. They are included for completeness and provenance. They add no scientific claim, and they override no accepted conclusion: PE-01's result and its scope are those of review/results/REVIEW.md, as reported in REPORT.md and narrowed by the scope of book/ch18-beyond.md:106.
superseded_or_historical_readings: A2 item 2 (LF-A): the owner's table entry 'Passive, not part of the deciding criterion' is superseded within A2 itself by the owner's clarification of 2026-10-26 that passive linear filters are fully eligible to produce deciding counterexamples. The pe01-resolutions block's value "LF-A": "passive" is read with that clarification.

A3 lists Rueppel (EUROCRYPT '87) and Gollmann–Chambers (1989) as works to read under its tagging rule. REPORT.md records them as unread, so no candidate-NEW tag is assignable. The tag annex A3 refers to is ../review/literature/.
A1, A2 and A3 refer to ../pe01/ (A2, A3), ../verdict.py (A2), ../results/ (A3) and ../review/literature/ (A3), which are on main.

historical_readings_in_other_records: PLAN.md uses 'PE-02' for the thread's computational-versus-physical-observers stage, now planned in #1092. It is not the charged-tables stage, which was drafted under the working name PE-02 and renamed PE-05 (#934).

Corpus line numbers in PLAN.md, REPORT.md and REVIEW.md refer to the corpus at c37700ad (PLAN.md:4-5): the branch never changed papers/ or book/, so the run head 549641460b8d has the same corpus. On main several cited lines have moved. Each mapping below is to the paragraph on main that begins with the same words; its text may since have been edited. book/ch18-beyond.md:114 (PLAN.md:296, 328; REPORT.md:28, 178, 191; REVIEW.md:22, 257) is now book/ch18-beyond.md:106, and its universal form was removed by #933 (merge 687e885b); ch18-beyond.md:106 states the narrowed existence form this pin supports. REVIEW.md:10's ch18-beyond.md:105-116 is now 97-108. FULL.md:4932 (REVIEW.md:257) was the mirror's line at c37700ad, 4934 at #933's base 52e2db40, and is 4919 on main. Main.md:560, the corollary 'single controlled dynamics' (PLAN.md:179, 182; REPORT.md:129; REVIEW.md:163), is now Main.md:582; Main.md:560 on main is a different proposition. Main.md:496 (PLAN.md:38, 57) is now Main.md:518, Main.md:708 (PLAN.md:57) is now Main.md:726, and Structure.md:1256 (PLAN.md:10, 326) is now Structure.md:1254. ch18-beyond.md:56 (PLAN.md:380; REPORT.md:135) is unchanged.
